thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — HIGH ERROR RATE detected for model rollout 'migration-v4' in prod. Affected endpoint: /v1/generate. Symptoms: 5xx and Tokenizer/Decode errors, token_errors metric up ~12x. Region: us-east-1. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

oncall-jamie: ack, I'm looking.

oncall-jamie: quick scan of gateway logs shows TokenizerMismatchError and decode offsets. Weightset name migration-v4-w-2026-03-17, tokenizer bundle not found in artifact metadata. Suspect release job omitted tokenizer package (config drift).

ml-eng-sana: confirming — the CI artifact for migration-v4 only uploaded weights, tokenizer artifact upload step failed in the pipeline (timeout). I can produce a patch to reattach tokenizer but that will take ~20-30m to validate. Recommend rollback/kill-switch to stop customer impact.

oncall-jamie: agreed. Flipping feature flag to turn off the new model immediately. Command I ran:
```
./rctl feature set model.migration_v4.enabled false --env prod --reason "pager: tokenizer mismatch"
```

deploy-bot: feature flag updated -> propagating to edge gateways (~30s).

deploy-bot: initiating alias rollback: prod/latest -> migration-v3-stable via rollout-service.

sre-lee: monitoring infra during rollback. Watching 5xx rate, stream decode errors, and latency tail. Will escalate if 5xx > 1% after 3 minutes.

support-ana: opened internal ticket TKT-1892 and assigned to support rotation. Drafting customer-facing message for affected customers.

deploy-bot: rollout status: in_progress -> 12 clusters -> rolling back. Warmup tasks queued.

ml-eng-sana: quick repro on canary shows decoding offsets like:
```
[2026-03-17T15:03:12Z] ERROR decode: TokenizerMismatchError: expected vocab size 50257 but got 50255
[2026-03-17T15:03:12Z] ERROR generation: failed to decode tokens -> incomplete output
```
This matches what prod logs show. Root cause: tokenizer bundle missing from release artifact + weight metadata pointing to newer tokenization scheme.

deploy-bot: rollback completed in all regions. Alias prod/latest now points to migration-v3-stable.

oncall-jamie: verifying metrics post-rollback: token_errors back to baseline 0.2% (was 5.4%). Latency and 5xx normalized. Sampling logs show no new decode errors.

oncall-jamie: handing off to ml-eng-sana for postmortem and release hygiene. Please capture timeline and remediation steps.

ml-eng-sana: will write postmortem. Initial action items: [1] Add tokenizer bundle presence check in release pipeline (fail release on missing bundle). [2] Add canary decode test that runs a small sample of known prompts through new artifact before routing traffic. [3] Add artifact metadata validation: tokenizer hash must match weightset expected tokenizer hash. [4] Update runbook with explicit kill-switch steps.

sre-lee: will add an alert for token_decode_mismatch and a dashboard tile for tokenizer/weights metadata drift.

product-paul: notified affected enterprise contacts; no immediate revenue impact reported but customers expect follow-up.

support-ana: support outreach queued, will attach logs and incident ID to TKT-1892 and follow up with affected accounts.

oncall-jamie: closing pager — rollback successful, monitoring for 30m. If anything reappears ping #oncall immediately. :white_check_mark: :rotating_light:

#postmortem-owners: ml-eng-sana (lead), sre-lee (alerts), deploy-platform (release checks), support-ana (customer comms)
